512-3990-7014.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-3990-7014.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3990-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1671-5231-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

647-2457-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

6720-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6720-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Primal Vigor.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2334-2724-3194.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Soulherder. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

147-5231-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5231-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

457-1458-4404-5645.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-5645.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Stenn.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

489-586-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

11-2928-6070-7089.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
You control at least two Doctors.
11-2928-6070-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting and returning the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

331-2191-4416.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
331-2191-4416.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Furnace of Rath, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-955-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-955-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-3875-4482-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-4482-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-4482-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Ancient Greenwarden, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

147-3440-5256.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

2086-6797-6824.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1737-3621-4853-5256.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3652-5330.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5330.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-1844-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
413-1844-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

2350-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2035-2523-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Gollum, adding {R}.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Repeat.

1339-2557-5349.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four tokens.
1339-2557-5349.description:
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat.

2003-3062-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
2003-3062-3609.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

394-2034-2948-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
394-2034-2948-4484.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-3362-4783.description:
Cast Hellkite Courser by paying {4}{R}{R}.
When Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hellkite Courser, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger, putting Bladewing the Risen from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bladewing the Risen, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Bladewing the Risen to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bladewing the Risen trigger from step 5, returning Hellkite Courser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1964-1987-2493-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1964-1987-2493-2510.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
